module_summary: Stepper motor controller with phase register, decoded output, and sub-instance step sequencer.

anchors.name: ph
anchors.why: Phase register; holds current motor phase (0-3), updated via sub-instance.

anchors.name: ph_n
anchors.why: Next phase from step unit; combinational output of sub-instance.

anchors.name: sense
anchors.why: 3-bit sensor input; fed to step sequencer for phase decisions.

anchors.name: act
anchors.why: 3-bit motor actuation output; decoded from ph register.

groups.name: Phase State Machine
groups.description: Phase register updated by external step sequencer sub-instance.

groups.name: Phase Decode
groups.description: Combinational decoder from 2-bit phase to 3-bit motor control.

groups.name: Sensor Input and Next-Phase Logic
groups.description: Sensor signals and combinational next-phase output from step unit.
